ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigation into the crackdown on Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and its impact on disabled recipients
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How is the crackdown affecting disabled recipients?
ideas.insight: The crackdown on Medicaid fraud in Minnesota has significant implications for disabled recipients, who may be left without housing or essential services. Further investigation is needed to understand the scope of the problem and the impact of the crackdown.
